result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major layout cutoff issue with the 'Fastest near you' section, a minor category filter cutoff, and a minor content truncation issue with restaurant name.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, showing only partial content
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indication is clear or adjust card width/spacing so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability with a partial card preview intentionally designed

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional category cut off at the right edge, not clearly indicating scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility cue to indicate more categories can be scrolled into view

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a text rendering error rather than an intentionally cut-off card
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis truncation to text or ensure the card boundary clearly indicates it's a partially visible scrollable item
